intro: 12 個發票情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: The customer service representative was responsible for telling all existing customers that higher prices would be charged next month.
ex.zh: 客服代表負責告知所有現有客戶,下個月將收取較高的價格。

ex.en: The extra charge for gift wrapping your purchase will appear on your invoice.
ex.zh: 禮品包裝的額外費用會出現在你的發票上。

note: extra charge 額外費用;free of charge 免費;in charge of 負責
charge sb for sth 就某事向某人收費
surcharge 附加費;overcharge 多收費

ex.en: I have compiled a list of the most popular items for sale on our website.
ex.zh: 我已經整理出一份我們網站上最熱賣商品的清單。

ex.en: The clerk is responsible for compiling the orders at the end of the day.
ex.zh: 這位職員負責在每天結束時彙整訂單。

note: compilation 彙編;compiler 編輯者、編譯器

ex.en: Let's make sure all invoices sent to customers are kept in alphabetical order.
ex.zh: 我們要確保寄給客戶的所有發票都按字母順序保存。

ex.en: Our customer satisfaction plan offers a discount to customers who pay their invoices on time.
ex.zh: 我們的客戶滿意計畫,對準時繳清發票的客戶提供折扣。

note: customer service 客戶服務;customer satisfaction 客戶滿意度

ex.en: Customers who pay their invoices before the end of the month receive a 5 percent discount.
ex.zh: 在月底前付清發票的客戶可享有百分之五的折扣。

ex.en: The discount on the sale items was not very big.
ex.zh: 特價商品的折扣不是很大。

note: at a discount 以折扣價;a 10 percent discount 九折

ex.en: Customers may dispute certain charges on an invoice.
ex.zh: 客戶可以對發票上的某些費用提出異議。

ex.en: A customer called the company to dispute the no returns policy.
ex.zh: 有位客戶打電話給公司,對不接受退貨的政策提出質疑。

note: dispute a charge 對費用提出異議
disputable 有爭議的;indisputable 無可爭辯的

ex.en: The accountant was so efficient in processing the receipts that she had the job done by lunch.
ex.zh: 這位會計處理收據非常有效率,午餐前就把工作做完了。

ex.en: Electronic invoicing has helped us to be efficient.
ex.zh: 電子發票幫助我們提高了效率。

note: efficient 指有效率;effective 指有效果
efficiency 效率;efficiently 有效率地;inefficient 沒效率的

ex.en: We estimated our losses this year at about five thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 我們估計今年的損失約為五千美元。

ex.en: The final cost of the project was not much more than the original estimate.
ex.zh: 這個專案的最終成本並沒有比原本的估價高出多少。

note: estimation 估計;underestimate 低估;overestimate 高估

ex.en: The company will impose a surcharge for any items returned.
ex.zh: 公司將對任何退回的商品加收附加費。

ex.en: We should not impose upon our staff by requiring them to work on weekends.
ex.zh: 我們不該要求員工週末上班而打擾他們。

note: impose sth on / upon sb 把⋯強加於某人
imposition 強加、負擔;imposing 壯觀的

ex.en: I made a mistake in adding up your bill and we overcharged you twenty dollars.
ex.zh: 我把你的帳單加錯了,多收了你二十美元。

ex.en: It was a mistake thinking that my boss would be reasonable when I explained my situation to him.
ex.zh: 當初我向老闆說明我的情況時,以為他會講理,那是個錯誤。

note: make a mistake 犯錯;by mistake 錯誤地

ex.en: We always reply promptly to customers' letters.
ex.zh: 我們總是迅速回覆客戶的來信。

ex.en: The new sales agent promptly offered a full refund for the damaged goods.
ex.zh: 這位新業務員立刻為受損的貨品提供全額退款。

ex.en: He rectified the problem by giving the customer credit for the unused items that she returned.
ex.zh: 他針對客戶退回的未使用商品給予抵用金,解決了這個問題。

ex.en: Embarrassed at his behavior, he rectified the situation by writing a letter of apology.
ex.zh: 他對自己的行為感到難為情,於是寫了一封道歉信來彌補。

note: rectification 矯正;rectifiable 可糾正的

ex.en: The terms of payment were clearly listed at the bottom of the invoice.
ex.zh: 付款條件清楚列在發票的底部。

ex.en: The terms of the agreement required that items be fully paid for before they would be shipped.
ex.zh: 協議條款要求貨品必須付清全款才會出貨。

note: 表「條件、條款」時用複數 terms
terms and conditions 條款與條件;terms of payment 付款條件;in terms of 就⋯而言
